items.readable_text:
Content:
How would we find the remainder in the division problem below?

Content:
[MATH: A]

Content:
First, we express our division as a multiplication problem. However, as well as multiplying, we add the remainder.

Content:
[MATH: 27 = 6 \times 4 \,\,+\,\, \bbox[3pt, white, border: 1px solid black]{\color{blue}?}]

Content:
Now, since [MATH: 6 \times 4 = 24,] the above equation becomes

Content:
[MATH: 27 = 24 \,\, +\,\, \bbox[3pt, white, border: 1px solid black]{\color{blue}?}.]

Content:
So, the remainder must be [MATH: {\color{blue}{3}}.]

Content:
[MATH: 27 = 24 \,+\, \bbox[3pt, white, border: 1px solid black]{\color{blue}3}]

Content:
Finally, we can write

Content:
[MATH: 27 \div 6 = 4 \, \textrm{R} \, \bbox[3pt, white, border: 1px solid black]{\color{blue}3}.]
